title: Graduate Engineer
location: Melbourne VIC (Terra Verde / Suburban Rail Loop tunnels)
content_text: Graduate Engineer Melbourne permanent full time on-site/office for Terra Verde JV (Webuild, GS E&C Australia, Bouygues Construction Australia) delivering nearly 10 km of parallel tunnels Glen Waverley to Box Hill for Suburban Rail Loop. Role supports engineering and construction activities, temporary works design/approval support, data analysis, design plan review, constructability, procurement support, non-conformance reporting, stakeholder relationships, risk management. Qualifications: Tertiary qualification in Engineering; Construction White Card; prior large-scale Australian infrastructure experience desirable but not required. Strong communication; proactive learner; work independently and in a team.
apply_instructions: Apply via Bouygues Construction careers portal. Students and graduates page also publishes byca.recruit@bouygues-construction.com.

title: Engineering Officer
abstract: Join Council as an Engineering Officer and help deliver vital infrastructure projects that keep our Southern Downs community moving forward
bullets: Free skin checks, flu vacs & wellness medicals & discounted gym memberships
content_text:
Your Opportunity
In this role, you will be provide technical assistance to the Construction and Maintenance Delivery Teams in the planning, design, construction delivery, asset lifecycle maintenance and project management of civil projects including roads (sealed and unsealed), bridges, culverts, stormwater (Kerb and Channell, Pipes and Open Drains), footpaths, cycleways, etc.
Council is committed to support and provide opportunities for continuing professional development on your journey to achieve your chartered accreditation and to obtain Registered Professional Engineers Queensland.
STATUS:
Permanent, Full-time
HOURS of WORK:
72.5 hours per fortnight | 9-day fortnight, or as negotiated with successful candidate
PAY LEVEL:
$3,123.71 – $3,846.49 per fortnight (Level 3 - 5)
Plus 12% Superannuation and 17.5% Annual Leave Loading in accordance with Council’s Enterprise Agreement and the relevant Award.
Pay rate dependant on relevant skills and experience. This will be administered under the graduate program and therefore development and progression will be accelerated.
EMPLOYMENT BASE:
Stanthorpe, Queensland
HOW TO APPLY:
Access the information package at: www.sdrc.qld.gov.au, or call 1300 MY SDRC (1300 697 372)
You must supply ALL information requested on the Vacancy Coversheet in your application.
If you have any additional enquiries in relation to the requirements of this position, please contact:
James Varughese, Principal Engineer on ph. 1300 697 372.
Send your full application to: employment@sdrc.qld.gov.au
APPLICATIONS CLOSE:
09:00AM – Tuesday, 3rd November 2026
What you will need in this role
For full details of this position, please ensure you download the Position Description.
To be considered for this role, you will need:
- Legal right to live and work in Australia.
MANDATORY LICENCES & QUALIFICATIONS
- A Class C (car) licence or greater is required in this role.
- An Occupational Health & Safety Construction Induction Card (White Card); or the ability to obtain before commencement.
- A Qualification of at least degree level in civil engineering.
- A current certificate for Working in Proximity to Traffic Awareness Parts 1 & 2, or have the ability to obtain.
Benefits of the position include:
- Discounted corporate health insurance plans
- Free skin checks, flu vacs & wellness medicals, including discounted gym memberships
- Health & wellbeing initiatives exclusive to Council employees
- Generous leave provisions, including Special Family Leave & Cultural Leave
- Employee Assistance Program for all staff and their families (24/7)
About Southern Downs
Southern Downs is a great place to live, work, play and stay. With a growing multicultural community of 27,040 residents, the picturesque region covers 7,122km and offers you the work-life balance you have been searching for in a well-connected regional centre. The major towns of Warwick and Stanthorpe offer vibrant commercial hubs with ample retail, medical, banking and educational services.
Act with Integrity | One Region, One Team | Lead by Example | Service Excellence | Our People, Our Strength
